import ast, base64, difflib, hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
path = Path('scripts/isaac/local45_fleet4_transport_scene.py')
before = base64.b64decode('')
after = path.read_bytes()
old_tree = ast.parse(before, filename=str(path))
new_tree = ast.parse(after, filename=str(path))
owner = next(node for node in new_tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'Local45FleetLifecycle')
added = [node for node in owner.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'before_capture']
assert len(added) == 1, 'expected one local45 override'
owner.body.remove(added[0])
assert ast.dump(old_tree, include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(new_tree, include_attributes=False), 'change outside owned override'
diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(before.decode('utf-8-sig').splitlines(True), after.decode('utf-8-sig').splitlines(True), fromfile='before/local45_fleet4_transport_scene.py', tofile='after/local45_fleet4_transport_scene.py'))
assert all(line[1:].rstrip('\r\n') == line[1:].rstrip('\r\n').rstrip(' \t') for line in diff if line.startswith('+') and not line.startswith('+++')), 'added trailing whitespace'
print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version.split()[0], 'ast_parse':'PASS', 'diff_scope':'only Local45FleetLifecycle.before_capture added; other AST unchanged', 'added_whitespace_check':'PASS', 'before_sha256':hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(), 'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()}))
print(''.join(diff), end='')
